source.note: Nominal 30 fps does not imply uniform source PTS. Trim uses original integer PTS with -copyts.

trim.reason: Exclude editor loading at 5.500/5.566667 and later Unity-exit browser desktop. Retain home, battle entry, Auto cycle and return home.

output.visual_region: Full original recorded rectangle; no spatial crop, no overlays, no synthetic frames
output.pts_preservation: Every output frame PTS equals selected source frame PTS minus 86016; all 158 compared successfully.

visual_inspection.method: Actual ffmpeg extraction followed by view_image inspection. Sample review plus exact first/last output frames; not a claim of frame-by-frame review of the entire clip.

overview.selection: Full raw source, fps=1, full-window overview. Resampled positions are approximate source selection times.

dense.selection: Original PTS [5,11), fps=4; game-region crop for inspection only. Labels are resampled fps-grid PTS, not exact source-frame PTS.

exact_start_boundary.selection: Every available source frame PTS from 5.500000 through 6.000000; exact PTS labels
exact_start_boundary.observation: 5.500000 and 5.566667 are empty loading views; 5.600000 onward is the game home.

exact_end_boundary.selection: Every available source frame PTS from 10.600000 through 11.133333; full-window views with exact PTS labels
exact_end_boundary.observation: Pause, then home; no exit desktop in this reviewed boundary range.

first_output_frame.observation: Game home visible in Unity Game view.

last_output_frame.observation: Game home visible; browser desktop excluded.

auto_hud.selection: Exact original integer PTS 102400,106496,114688,155648; crop=408:716:1016:84 for inspection only

visual_inspection.recorded_foreground_warning: run.json reports foreground warnings; acceptance is based on visible game content in the inspected source/excerpt frames and full decoding.
